probes.check: am_probe_jolt_jobs(): one PhysicsSystem::Update with two active bodies; the shared scheduler's jolt counter rises and no thread outside the scheduler ran a Jolt job.
probes.seeded_violation: Construct JPH::JobSystemThreadPool in place of the adapter, so Jolt runs its own threads.

adaptation_notes: The adapter derives from JPH::JobSystemWithBarrier and submits each Jolt job to am::jobs; GetMaxConcurrency returns the choices header's worker count.
The adapter counts jobs in flight; am_unbind_jolt_jobs() waits for the count to reach zero before destroying it, or a worker can still be running a Jolt job.
Translation units that derive from Jolt classes compile with -fno-rtti (MSVC /GR-); Jolt's build fragment sets this on the glue target.
